q=quotes.copy()
q['name']=q.vendor.map(vendors.set_index('vendor')['name'])
e=q[(q.comparable)&(q.cleared_questionnaire)&(~q.not_quoted)]
r=e.loc[e.groupby('rm_code').cost_inr_per_spec_kg.idxmin()]
allc=q[q.comparable].groupby('rm_code').cost_inr_per_spec_kg.min()
r=r.assign(ca=r.rm_code.map(allc))
r['Status']=r.risk_flags.apply(lambda f:'Hold' if ('CLAIM_CONTRADICTED' in f or 'LATE' in f) else 'Proceed')
result=pd.DataFrame({'Line':r.rm_code,'Vendor':r.name,'Rs/kg':r.cost_inr_per_spec_kg.round(0),'Cheapest overall':r.ca.round(0),'Spend INR':r.spend_inr.round(0),'Status':r.Status})
print(result.Status.value_counts())
